title: Media and Collaboration Promos: card flavor text

entities.name: Mercadians
entities.description: People who live atop their mountains, compared to the lightning hounds.

entities.name: Jhovall
entities.description: Mountain creatures that lightning hounds avoid alone and attack in packs.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The mechanical world that, according to scripture, evolved from void and was seen as perfect by Yawgmoth.

entities.name: Dal
entities.description: A people with a myth about a wurm whose flowstone spines took the shapes of dead villagers' heads.

entities.name: Greven il-Vec
entities.description: A figure who lifts Vhati off his feet in punishment for failure.

entities.name: Vhati
entities.description: A figure punished by Greven il-Vec for his failure.

entities.name: Kor
entities.description: A people with a saying that lightning tethers souls to the world.

entities.name: Ultimecia
entities.description: A fearful sorceress whose heart is filled with anger and hate.

entities.name: Edea Kramer
entities.description: Speaker who describes Ultimecia as a fearful sorceress.

entities.name: Hanna
entities.description: A character who fights a sliver swarm and finds the artificial slivers were not its leaders.

entities.name: Kaalia
entities.description: A character who found she was not alone in the vast emptiness.

entities.name: Peter Parker
entities.description: A hero who visits Aunt May and says heroes save people.

entities.name: Aunt May
entities.description: Peter Parker's aunt, who was making his favorite.

entities.name: Aang
entities.description: A young monk taught by Monk Gyatso to live with joy.

entities.name: Monk Gyatso
entities.description: Aang's teacher, who taught him many things, most importantly to live with joy.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: The Father of Machines, who saw Phyrexia's perfection and began the Grand Evolution.

entities.name: Phyrexian Scriptures
entities.description: Phyrexian religious writings describing Phyrexia's origin and the Grand Evolution.

entities.name: Grand Evolution
entities.description: The process begun by Yawgmoth after he saw Phyrexia's perfection.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: A magical university meant to serve students from across the Planes.

entities.name: Kasmina
entities.description: A speaker who welcomes students to Strixhaven.

entities.name: The Collector
entities.description: A collector who shows off his newest acquisitions, the Guardians of the Galaxy.

entities.name: Guardians of the Galaxy
entities.description: A group held as The Collector's newest acquisitions.

entities.name: Shuri
entities.description: An inventor who enjoys rhythms as complex as her algorithms.

entities.name: Steve Rogers
entities.description: A hero who was still there through the perilous fight.

entities.name: Sazh
entities.description: Owner of an unnamed chocobo chick.

entities.name: Cocoon
entities.description: A place where ripples of destiny might spread.

entities.name: Eden
entities.description: A place where a hurricane might be caused.

entities.name: Dominion
entities.description: An enemy power that Benjamin Sisko hopes descendants will someday rise up against.

entities.name: Benjamin Sisko
entities.description: A commander resolved to go down fighting against the Dominion.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: A speaker who once watched a raptor rip a Phyrexian dreadnought in half.

events.summary: Greven il-Vec lifts Vhati off his feet to punish him for his failure.
events.quote: Greven *il*-Vec lifted Vhati off his feet. "The fall will give you time to think on your failure."

events.summary: Hanna discovers the destroyed artificial slivers were not the swarm's leaders.
events.quote: "They clearly were not the leaders," Hanna cursed.

events.summary: Kaalia finds she is not alone in the vast emptiness.
events.quote: In the vast emptiness, Kaalia found she was not alone.

events.summary: In the past, Monk Gyatso taught Aang to live with joy.
events.quote: Monk Gyatso taught Aang many things, most importantly to live with joy.

events.quote: Great Yawgmoth, Father of Machines, saw its perfection. Thus the Grand Evolution began.
